news.title: X announces a rebuilt ad platform powered by AI
news.description: X is rolling out a rebuilt ads platform powered by AI as it works to grow revenue again.

news.title: Meta says its business AI now facilitates 10 million conversations a week
news.description: Meta said over 8 billion advertisers have used at least one of its GenAI tools

news.title: Sources: Anthropic could raise a new $50B round at a valuation of $900B
news.description: The maker of Claude has received multiple pre-emptive offers at valuations in the $850 billion to $900 billion range, according to sources familiar with the matter.

news.title: OpenAI tells ChatGPT models to stop talking about goblins
news.description: The AI firm said that unlike previous model bugs, the issue "crept in subtly".

news.title: Musk accuses OpenAI lawyer of trying to 'trick' him in combative testimony
news.description: Elon Musk was cross-examined on the third day of the trial over his lawsuit against Sam Altman and OpenAI.

news.title: Why friendly AI chatbots might be less trustworthy
news.description: Researchers found adjusting AI systems to be more warm and friendly to users would result in an "accuracy trade-off".

news.title: These Men Allegedly Profit Off Teaching People How to Make AI Porn
news.description: Three Arizona women have filed a lawsuit against a group of men that alleges they used the women’s photos to make AI porn influencers, then offered online courses showing others how to do it.

news.title: Reid Hoffman Thinks Doctors Should Ask AI for a Second Opinion
news.description: The LinkedIn cofounder now has an AI drug discovery startup—and thinks not asking chatbots for medical advice is “bordering on committing malpractice.”
